audit_findings.title: Growth may be forecast without deducting the reinvestment that produces it
audit_findings.magnitude: unquantified; filed fiscal-2026 capital-expenditure ceiling is $450m, while the computed growth premium over BEAR is $2,493m in BASE and $4,390m in BULL
audit_findings.mechanism: The model grows the $1,157.3m OE anchor by 3% or 5% without separately deducting the incremental capital expenditure and working capital required to support that growth.
audit_findings.evidence: We expect capital expenditures will not be greater than $450 million in fiscal 2026 and will primarily be used to fund our new, remodeled, and relocated stores and strategic priorities, including investments in information technology systems and supply chain optimization.
audit_findings.explanation: This is an unresolved modeling omission rather than a quantified error because the filing does not divide the $450m capital budget between maintenance and growth. It is material: growth adds $57.16 per share in BASE and $100.68 per share in BULL, and roughly half of scenario value comes from terminal value, so even a modest recurring reinvestment charge could materially reduce those cases.
audit_findings.action: Classify maintenance, remodeling, technology, supply-chain and expansion spending; estimate incremental working capital; subtract scenario-specific reinvestment from annual OE and rerun BASE and BULL.

audit_findings.title: The null perimeter ruling conflicts with the midyear Space NK acquisition
audit_findings.magnitude: filed acquisition value $399.152m, equal to $9.15 per diluted share; Space NK represented 4% of filed total assets
audit_findings.mechanism: The FY2026 OE anchor contains only operations after the July 10 acquisition, while the valuation-date equity owns Space NK for the full forecast period; acquisition debt, cash and liabilities also enter the bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: The results of operations of Space NK are included in the consolidated financial statements since the date of the acquisition.
audit_findings.explanation: The null perimeter is demonstrably incorrect, but the filed scale does not support a conclusion-changing effect. The filing calls the acquisition immaterial, and even the entire $399.152m acquisition value equals only $9.15 per share, versus the $142.84 per-share gap between market price and the BULL value. Profitability and maintenance requirements remain unquantified, so the direction cannot be established, but the recorded transaction scale is insufficient to reverse the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Prepare a full-year Space NK OE schedule and reconcile its $52.578m latest debt, cash, working capital and maintenance needs; rerun for accuracy even though the disclosed scale is not conclusion-changing.

audit_findings.title: The Mexico joint venture may be omitted from both earnings and the bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: filed affiliate losses of $3.857m in FY2025 and $3.652m in the latest 26 weeks; FY2025 total other-investment outflows were $39.704m
audit_findings.mechanism: The anchor adds back the equity-method loss while the bridge assigns no value to the stake; continuing cash contributions would also need to reduce OE or the separately valued stake.
audit_findings.evidence: Equity net loss of affiliate was $3.9 million in fiscal 2025 related to our joint venture in Mexico.
audit_findings.explanation: The perimeter inconsistency is demonstrated, but the identified loss is only 0.33% of the $1,157.3m anchor. Capitalizing the $3.857m loss at the BASE model's OE multiple would affect value by about $1.24 per share. Even all $39.704m of FY2025 other-investment outflows—not all of which are shown to relate to Mexico—equals only $0.91 per share as a direct bridge amount. These scales are far below the $142.84 gap to BULL value. Excluding losses overstates value, while omitting the stake understates value.
audit_findings.action: Trace Mexico contributions within other investments, obtain the stake carrying value and distributable cash-flow forecast, and rerun only if evidence identifies amounts materially beyond the filed figures.

audit_findings.title: The latest-quarter bridge still lacks a complete manual liability reconciliation
audit_findings.magnitude: filed restricted cash of $2.299m, or $0.05 per diluted share; other potentially unavailable cash is unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: The bridge adds $213.451m of cash and short-term investments, but cash held for sellers or subject to other non-operating claims is not available to common equity and must be excluded or offset by the corresponding claim.
audit_findings.evidence: Includes restricted cash of $ 2,299 , which consists of UB Marketplace TM proceeds held for payment due to third-party sellers as of January 31, 2026.
audit_findings.explanation: A $2.299m overstatement is demonstrated, but it is only 1.08% of cash and short-term investments and 0.014% of BASE equity value, so that item alone is not material. Because the requested manual reconciliation was not completed, the record does not establish whether additional restricted cash or non-operating claims exist or how large they are.
audit_findings.action: Manually reconcile the $158.451m cash balance and each latest-quarter liability category, identify amounts already reflected through equity-level OE, and rerun the bridge after excluding all unavailable cash without double-counting operating liabilities, debt or leases.

audit_findings.title: Signed but uncommenced leases have no cost in the historical anchor
audit_findings.magnitude: filed $128.445m of undiscounted legally binding lease payments, equal to $2.95 per diluted share before considering associated store earnings
audit_findings.mechanism: Future rent, opening costs, capital expenditure and working capital for signed locations enter forecast OE and growth; the payments are absent from historical expense and the recorded lease liability until commencement.
audit_findings.evidence: Operating lease payments exclude $ 128,445 of legally binding minimum lease payments for leases signed but not yet commenced.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a forward-looking commitment, not a demonstrated omission from historical OE. Treating the full commitment as debt would ignore the revenue and earnings from the associated stores, but forecasting their growth without their costs would overstate value. Materiality therefore depends on store-level opening economics not supplied in the record.
audit_findings.action: Monitor commencement schedules and incorporate each location's rent, pre-opening expense, capital spending, inventory investment and expected earnings into the same forecast period.

audit_findings.title: One-time Space NK transaction costs may depress the anchor
audit_findings.mechanism: Transaction costs included in SG&A reduce the FY2026 OE anchor; removing demonstrably nonrecurring costs would increase normalized OE and all scenario values.
audit_findings.evidence: Transaction costs related to the acquisition of Space NK were expensed as incurred and are included in selling, general and administrative expenses in the consolidated statements of income.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing proves that transaction costs were expensed, but it does not disclose their amount. The resulting understatement is therefore possible rather than quantified, and the record cannot establish whether normalization would be material. Partial-period Space NK earnings and recurring integration or international overhead must not be normalized away with genuine transaction costs.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the transaction-cost ledger or acquisition footnote detail, isolate only nonrecurring advisory, legal and closing costs, apply the appropriate tax effect, and rerun the anchor and scenarios.

audit_findings.title: Unidentified D&A is conservatively left in owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: computed FY2024 residual approximately $0.840m, or about $0.27 per share under the BASE valuation multiple
audit_findings.mechanism: Any eligible residual D&A left as an expense reduces OE; reclassification as a non-economic add-back would raise the anchor or historical normalization.
audit_findings.evidence: identified eligible D&A is below the filed composite; residual is conservatively left as an expense, not added back: FY2024 $243.0m (99.6% of filed D&A)
audit_findings.explanation: The treatment is conservative and cannot overstate value. Identified eligible D&A of $243.0m covers 99.6% of filed FY2024 D&A of $243.840m, leaving approximately $0.840m. That is only 0.07% of the $1,157.3m anchor and would change BASE value by roughly $0.27 per share, far below the $186.36 market-price gap to BASE value.
audit_findings.action: Classify the residual from filed fixed-asset or amortization schedules; rerun only if additional residual amounts beyond the computed $0.840m are identified.
